name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)

eligibility.other_conditions: Studying in class IX in a government or local body school, having secured at least 55% marks in class VIII exam.

benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum (Rs. 1,000 per month) from Class IX through Class XII to arrest dropout rates.
application_process: Appear for the state-level NMMSS selection exam conducted in Class VIII.
Selected students register on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
Disbursement occurs through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
